note: Evolution relationships for every Pokemon that belongs to an evolution family, scraped from PokemonDB's evolution chart. Species NOT present in this file have no evolution relationships at all (single-stage, no pre-evolution or evolution) -- cross-check against pokemon_base_stats.json for the full species list. Each record: name (form-specific, e.g. "Alolan Vulpix"), baseName (plain species name), dexNum, slug (pokemondb URL slug), type1/type2, evolvesFrom (null for base-stage species, else {condition, name, dexNum} of the pre-evolution), evolvesTo (list of {condition, name, dexNum} for each evolution -- more than one entry means a branching evolution, e.g. Eevee or Tyrogue). Condition text is verbatim from PokemonDB (e.g. "Level 16", "use Water Stone", "trade holding Metal Coat", "high Friendship, Daytime") and may reference mechanics from any generation/game (Legends: Arceus, Let's Go, etc.) -- read the condition text itself rather than assuming a single game's rules.
